metadata.description: Adult self-report screening scale for symptoms associated with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder.
metadata.intended_use: Initial adult ADHD screening in research and clinical pathways, followed by diagnostic assessment.
metadata.name_origin: Adult ADHD Self-Report Scale, abbreviated ASRS.
metadata.development_history: Developed through a WHO collaborative process; short and full forms are used in different settings.
metadata.measurement_rationale: Inattention and hyperactivity/impulsivity symptoms are sampled as a first-stage screen for adult assessment.
metadata.interpretation_notes: A positive screen is not an ADHD diagnosis; developmental history, impairment, differential diagnosis, and informant evidence are required.

versions.source_citation: Kessler et al. (2005). The World Health Organization Adult ADHD Self-Report Scale (ASRS).

source_documents.title: WHO Adult ADHD Self-Report Scale reference
source_documents.license_name: Metadata reference; exact German edition and reuse terms require source review
source_documents.permission_basis: Only discovery and bibliographic metadata is stored. Item wording and forms are excluded until the exact German version and reuse terms are verified.
